scope: Fresh web audit, not restricted to repository bibliography

sources.name: An open-source heuristic to reboot 2D nesting research (Sparrow)
sources.access_evidence: Primary v3 abstract read 2026-09-22. Describes an open-source collision-resolution heuristic and ten new real-world benchmark instances. Code and instances not downloaded or run.
sources.license_note: Code and dataset reuse terms not verified
sources.novelty_overlap: Geometric collision repair for irregular manufacturing nesting is established; local synthetic nesting does not establish novelty.

sources.name: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for 2D Irregular Nesting
sources.representation: continuous polygon geometry with cross-polygon attention
sources.access_evidence: Primary v2 abstract read 2026-09-22. Describes Polygons Transformer, combinatorial-optimization RL, a geographic-contour training dataset and evaluation benchmark. Archive availability and contents not validated.
sources.license_note: Reuse rights not verified
sources.novelty_overlap: Learning geometric relations and optimizing irregular nesting already has direct prior art; this local diagnostic is not a novel method.

sources.name: OmniRouting
sources.representation: PCB geometry, nets, design rules, schematic semantics and tool feedback
sources.access_evidence: Primary abstract and official project page read 2026-09-22. Reports 1681 boards. Official sample-data link resolves to five_boards_exp_inputs.zip on Drive; archive contents not downloaded or validated.
sources.license_note: Dataset reuse rights not verified
sources.novelty_overlap: Direct overlap with constraint-aware geometric routing, connectivity checks and iterative tool feedback. The local routing pilot does not establish a novel benchmark concept.

sources.name: PCBWorld
sources.representation: native KiCad boards and interactive routing actions
sources.access_evidence: Primary v4 abstract and official LGAI-Research/PCBWorld README read 2026-09-22. Reports synthetic generators, 679 real boards, rule-based, RL and LLM baselines. Not installed or evaluated locally.
sources.license_note: README states BSD-3-Clause wrapper and GPLv3 engine; individual board data terms require separate review
sources.novelty_overlap: Direct prior work for engine-grounded routing with design-rule feedback and synthetic-to-real training.

sources.name: PCB-Bench (ICLR 2026)

Verified 2026-09-23: CANARY.md states "BENCHMARK DATA - DO NOT TRAIN ON THIS CONTENT" with a unique GUID emitted in every results.json. Evaluation only; never training or retrieval.
sources.representation_correction: Previously recorded as hardware_cad_svg_dxf. Direct inspection of the clone on 2026-09-23 contradicts that: the repository holds 0 DXF files, and of 67 SVG files 62 are Open Graph leaderboard preview cards under site/assets/og/models, 1 is a failure-gallery placeholder, and the 3 task assets are each self-labelled "Synthetic" and under 1.2 kB. It is a parametric CAD and DFM benchmark of 69 task.py/grader.py families, not a corpus of engineering drawings. Only 4 of 69 tasks mention SVG at all.
sources.prior_art_overlap: beam_bending_dfm computes section modulus, bending stress, deflection and safety factor from section geometry, which is the same physics as the peak-stress check in eng-frame/eng-svg. Relevant as prior art for solver-verified engineering reasoning, not as a data source.
